title: Gentle Reset Daily Exfoliating Pads to Smooth + Minimize Pores with AHAs

specifications.ingredientPreferences: ahaGlycolicAcid, crueltyFree, siliconeFree, parabenFree, fragranceFree, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Lactic Acid✓ Fragrance Free✓ Good for: Uneven Texture✓ AHA/Glycolic Acid✓ Good for: Pores

What it is: Formulated in Korea for daily use, these dual-sided pads smooth texture and even tone for brighter, more radiant looking skin.


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily


Skincare Concerns: Anti-Aging, Dryness, and Dullness


Formulation: Wipes


Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan and cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to Know: Gentle enough for daily use, these pads feature exfoliating, soothing, and hydrating ingredients to smooth skin, visibly even skin tone, and reduce the appearance of pores without irritation.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

- On clean, dry skin, glide pad over face, neck and décolletage.

- Use once daily or as needed, then follow with moisturizer.

- Start with the smooth side to apply the formula, then use the textured side on - congested or flaky areas to buff away dead skin cells.

- Avoid the eye area.

- Use SPF during the day.

Ingredients+
Water (Aqua/Eau), Butylene Glycol, Propanediol, 1,2- Hexanediol, Gluconolactone, Pentylene Glycol, Lactic Acid, Mandelic Acid, Panthenol, Glycolic Acid, Betaine Salicylate, Houttuynia Cordata (Heartleaf) Extract, Aloe Barbadensis (Aloe Vera) Leaf Water, Cynanchum Atratum (Bai Wei) Extract, Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Oil, Althaea Rosea (Common Hollyhock) Flower Extract, Glycerin, Caffeine, Betaine, Allantoin, Arginine, Polyglyceryl- 10 Isostearate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Caprylyl Glycol, Polyglyceryl-10 Oleate, Sodium Phytate, Sodium Hydroxide, C12-14 Alketh-12.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
